(Currently amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving, __with a user device__, a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating, __with the user device__, at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product __and based at least partially on a user profile__.
